_comment: Copy to style.json to make it this server's default look. Read at submit time, so an edit applies to the next job with no restart. Every key is optional; anything you leave out keeps its built-in default, and a malformed file falls back to the defaults rather than failing the job. Unknown keys are ignored.

hook._comment: Burns the viral_hook_text the AI already writes for every clip. Off unless you set enabled. duration_seconds: null shows it for the whole clip. style: classic | dark | yellow | red | outline | outline_yellow. size: S | M | L.

_comment_variants: Renders per clip. 'auto' is the pipeline's own per-scene framing and is always delivered; adding 'safe' delivers a second render of every clip — the whole 16:9 frame on a blurred background, camera fixed, no subject choice — as a fallback when the automatic framing gets it wrong. The dashboard pre-ticks it per job, but that only covers the dashboard: without this key a batch, the CLI and MCP agents each get one render, because resolve_variants falls back to ['auto']. Disk doubles, ~82MB per clip becomes ~164MB with captions on both, so raise OUTPUT_MAX_GB before turning this on. Ignored when output_format is horizontal (nothing to reframe) and in cloud mode.
